title: Open Workout Schema v0: routine
description: A routine: a person's own plan for a session, with targets to train from. Targets are never performed work; a workout records what was done. Draft; may change until v1.

ows_version.description: The Open Workout Schema version the document was written to, as MAJOR.MINOR (SPEC.md, section 8).

id.description: Assigned by the server that stores the routine.

source.description: The program this routine was copied from, when it was copied from a library entry. Absent once that entry is withdrawn.

row.description: One exercise in the routine and its targets, in order. Every target is optional: a plan may name only the exercise.

exercise_id.description: An Open Exercise ID (oec:…), or another namespace's, such as a person's own exercise (usr:…).

equipment.description: The exercise's equipment, as the server's catalogue lists it.

reps_max.description: With reps_min, a rep range to work within.

rule.description: How the row's next weight is suggested; absent means the server's default for the row's shape. linear adds the increment when every set reaches reps_min; double works up the rep range, then adds it. off makes no suggestion.
